project_type: Next.js 14 App Router multi-tenant WhatsApp Business SaaS (TypeScript, React 18, server route handlers under src/app/api)
build_system: Next.js 14.1.0 build via npm. `npm run build` = `prisma generate && next build`. Prisma 5.x uses the libSQL/Turso driver adapter (previewFeatures = ["driverAdapters"]); datasource provider is sqlite with url env(TURSO_DATABASE_URL). QUIRK: prisma db push CANNOT connect over libsql://, so all live schema changes ship via idempotent @libsql/client scripts under scripts/.
test_framework: None configured (no test runner, no test deps in package.json). Verification is `npm run build` + `npm run lint` + static trace + live-DB checks via throwaway @libsql/client snippets. Do NOT introduce a test framework for this task unless a feature explicitly requires it.
verification_instructions: 1) node scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs twice (second run = clean no-op, exit 0). 2) npm run build must pass (prisma generate picks up ApiKey, next build compiles routes/pages). 3) npm run lint must pass. 4) Confirm ApiKey table + ApiKey_keyHash_key + ApiKey_userId_idx exist on live Turso (PRAGMA table_info / index_list via throwaway @libsql/client snippet, then delete it). 5) Prove key lifecycle: create key -> plaintext returned once, DB stores only keyHash+keyPrefix -> authenticate /api/v1 call (200) -> revoke -> re-call (401); throwaway script OR static trace + step-2 live-schema check. 6) Static trace of POST /api/v1/messages confirming no client number/credential accepted and symmetric credit math. 7) Diff session send route observable behavior (codes/strings/success body) vs pre-refactor; only internal 402->400 remap differs. 8) grep -rn "wa_live_|keyHash" src -> no logged secret. 9) Remove throwaway scripts, KEEP scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs, clean tree, commit on main (NO push, NO worktree).
snapshot_or_generated_files: `prisma generate` regenerates the typed client into node_modules (not committed). No committed generated/snapshot files. The migration script scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs is a KEPT source artifact (run against live Turso, not auto-generated).
environment_constraints: Live-DB steps need TURSO_DATABASE_URL + TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN in .env (present; .env and .env.example are the user's open editor files). If live Turso is unreachable in the execution environment, fall back to static trace for lifecycle and state that explicitly, but the migration MUST be run against live Turso before the final commit. Never log or echo the plaintext key, keyHash, or decrypted tokens. ENCRYPTION_KEY is a 32-byte base64 AES-256-GCM key used by src/lib/crypto.ts (needed only at send time, not for key auth).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md; README.md exists. Global user rule: maintain scratchpad.md at repo root and update it in the SAME change set with a dated Change log entry (newest first) whenever features/endpoints/schema/deps change. Do not put secrets in scratchpad.md. No new dependencies for this task (zod, Node crypto, Prisma, @/components/ui/* primitives suffice).
key_patterns: Session routes authenticate with getServerSession(authOptions) from @/lib/auth and scope every query by session.user.id. Superadmin is EMAIL-DRIVEN in the NextAuth JWT callback (email === (SUPERADMIN_EMAIL||"neanvtech@gmail.com") ? "superadmin" : role); the DB role column is NEVER set to "superadmin" (admin-users route only grants "admin"), so a public path must use the shared isSuperAdminUser({email,role}) predicate, not the raw DB role. Per-tenant send credentials come from resolveSendCredentials(number) in src/lib/whatsapp.ts (decrypts accessToken; returns {null,null} or throws on bad key -> treat as 'no creds'). Crypto helpers in src/lib/crypto.ts (AES-256-GCM, lazy key, never logs). Migration scripts mirror scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs (manual .env parse, PRAGMA probe for log line only, CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS unconditionally, process.exit(1) on error, client.close() in finally). UI pages are "use client", use @/components/ui/{card,button,input,label,badge} + lucide-react, render inside DashboardShell (Header+Sidebar+Footer, already responsive). Docs page src/app/docs/page.tsx uses local CodeBlock/Method helpers and a toc array.
